title: Optical Flow
text: 估计对象速度，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；按 {Stop iterative solution} 指定停止迭代求解 When maximum number of iterations is；{Method} 指定光流计算方法、{Compute optical flow between} 指定计算光流 Current frame and N-th frame、{N} 指定帧数、{Smoothness factor} 指定平滑度因子、{Maximum number of iterations} 指定最大迭代次数、{Velocity output} 指定光流输出 Magnitude-squared、{Temporal gradient filter} 用于时间梯度的滤波器 Difference filter、{Number of input frames to buffer} 为平滑而缓冲的输入帧数、{Standard deviation for image smoothing filter} 指定图像平滑滤波器的标准差、{Standard deviation for gradient smoothing filter} 指定梯度平滑滤波器的标准差、{Discard normal flow estimates when constraint equation is ill-conditioned} 指定丢弃法向流估计、{Output image corresponding to motion vectors (accounts for block delay)} 指定与运动向量对应的输出图像、{Threshold for noise reduction} 指定降噪阈值，按实例取值。

ports.name: I/I1
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: |V|^2
ports.summary: 速度幅值 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: 复数形式的速度分量 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Method
params.values: 光流计算方法 Horn-Schunck (default) | Lucas-Kanade

params.name: Compute optical flow between
params.values: 计算光流 Current frame and N-th frame back (default) | Two images

params.name: Stop iterative solution
params.values: 停止迭代求解 When maximum number of iterations is reached (default) | When velocity difference falls below threshold | Whichever comes first

params.name: Velocity output
params.values: 光流输出 Magnitude-squared (default) | Horizontal and vertical components in complex form

params.name: Temporal gradient filter
params.values: 用于时间梯度的滤波器 Difference filter [-1 1] (default) | Derivative of Gaussian

params.name: Number of input frames to buffer
params.values: 为平滑而缓冲的输入帧数 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation for image smoothing filter
params.values: 图像平滑滤波器的标准差 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation for gradient smoothing filter
params.values: 梯度平滑滤波器的标准差 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Discard normal flow estimates when constraint equation is ill-conditioned
params.values: 丢弃法向流估计 off (default) | on

params.name: Output image corresponding to motion vectors (accounts for block delay)
params.values: 与运动向量对应的输出图像 off (default) | on
